description: For a traveller who wants to manage a booking here, in the chat, and does not have its reference: every booking on the mobile they booked with. Two calls. First pass the mobile alone (with country if it is not written with +): Vuelo texts that number a 6-digit code, and the answer is the same whether or not it has bookings. Ask the traveller for the code, then call again with the same mobile and the code: you get each booking's reference, what it is, its dates, its status (booked, reserved, cancelled, awaiting_payment, payment_link_expired), and the date to pay by or to cancel free by. Show them the list and ask which one. Then use get_booking, cancel_booking or request_change with that reference and this mobile. Never names, dates of birth or booking pages. If the code is not right, ask them to check the text; after five wrong tries, call again without the code for a new one.

code.description: The 6-digit code Vuelo texted, once the traveller has read it out. Leave out on the first call.

country.description: For a mobile typed the local way (06 12 34 56 78), the country it is from, as an ISO code (FR). Not needed for a number with +.

mobile.description: The mobile the traveller booked with.

name: list_my_bookings
title: The traveller's Vuelo bookings
